acceptance_criteria.description: New Ratings and pre-migration rows have VISIBLE Visibility and only the two defined values are accepted.
ADMIN can hide and unhide, receiving 200 and the updated Rating; nonexistent IDs return 404 and missing, null, or invalid Visibility returns 400.
Hidden Ratings are excluded from public page content, totalElements, totalPages, and average; all-hidden products return an empty list and 0.0 average.
Backoffice lists visible and hidden Ratings with their Visibility, while row actions toggle it and hidden rows show a Hidden badge.
Reloading the Storefront product page after hiding or unhiding reflects the public list, count, and average.
Hide and unhide preserve createdOn and creation attribution, use usual modification auditing, and a repeated state does not save again.
DELETE remains functional and deprecated in Swagger, but is no longer offered by the Backoffice reviews row.
A Customer cannot create a replacement Rating for a product after their existing Rating is hidden.
Authenticated non-ADMIN requests to change Visibility receive 403 and do not modify persistence.

decisions.decision: Replace the Backoffice row Delete button with Hide or Unhide, retaining DELETE only as a deprecated Swagger operation.
decisions.rationale: User accepted the recommendation; reversible moderation satisfies Legal's goal without removing the compatibility endpoint.
decisions.title: Replace destructive staff action

decisions.decision: A hidden original Rating continues to block another Rating by the same Customer for that Product.
decisions.rationale: User accepted the recommendation; hiding preserves the record and must not allow moderation bypass.
decisions.title: Retain original submission restriction

decisions.decision: Return 200 with updated Rating, 404 for unknown ID, 400 for missing/null/invalid Visibility, and success without saving for the same state; no visible Ratings yields 0.0 average and empty totals.
decisions.rationale: User accepted all recommended edge cases and existing empty-average behavior is preserved.
decisions.title: Define update and empty-result behavior

decisions.decision: Use persisted VISIBLE and HIDDEN values, default and backfill VISIBLE, filter only public reads, and expose both states to staff.
decisions.rationale: YAS-104 AC-1 through AC-5 explicitly define the state and publication behavior; Visibility is not soft deletion.
decisions.title: Model reversible publication Visibility

decisions.decision: Preserve creation fields and existing modification auditing and do not alter the shared audit listener.
decisions.rationale: User accepted the recommendation; YAS-104 AC-7 and exclusions do not authorize a new moderator audit trail.
decisions.title: Preserve usual audit semantics

glossary.meaning: A Customer-authored product review containing content and a star score.
Reversible publication state VISIBLE or HIDDEN; HIDDEN retains the Rating but excludes it from public lists and averages.

narrative.goal: Introduce reversible Rating Visibility so administrators can hide abusive feedback without deleting customer-authored content. Hidden Ratings remain available to staff but disappear from Storefront lists, counts, and average star scores on the next load.
narrative.notes: Standalone Mode: `wegactl context fetch YAS-104` reported Code Square unavailable. Task branch was explicitly approved to start from `wega/architecture`, since its architecture PR has not been merged into main. The ticket's Storefront client path is inaccurate: current code uses `storefront/modules/rating/services/RatingService.ts`; no client behavior change is required for next-load server filtering.
out_of_scope: Moderation reason and audit trail identifying the moderator.
Customer notification and realtime Storefront updates.
New frontend test frameworks, shared audit refactoring, unrelated UI loading/search fixes, and new Modules.
risks: Frontends have build and lint scripts but no automated UI test runner; browser smoke verification must be reported separately.
Integration tests require Docker, PostgreSQL and Keycloak containers, and Java 25; unavailable prerequisites must be reported, not installed.
Existing tests disable Liquibase and MVC unit tests disable security filters; dedicated migration and enabled-filter tests are required.
Shared modification auditing conditionally handles lastModifiedBy; preserve its existing semantics rather than adding a moderator audit feature.
Sealed graph counts are floors with 141 ambiguous and 13071 unresolved calls; JPA and Spring dispatch need runtime verification.

requirements.statement: Persist VISIBLE or HIDDEN Visibility, default new Ratings to VISIBLE, and migrate existing Ratings to VISIBLE.
Change Visibility through PUT /backoffice/ratings/{id}/visibility with a validated visibility body and return the updated Rating.
Return only VISIBLE Ratings and matching pagination totals and averages from Storefront Rating endpoints; return zero average when none are visible.
Return all Ratings with Visibility to Backoffice and replace row Delete with Hide or Unhide and a Hidden badge.
Retain existing DELETE functionality and mark its Swagger operation deprecated.
Preserve duplicate-submission restrictions even when the Customer's existing Rating is HIDDEN.
Preserve creation audit fields and usual modification auditing; repeating the same Visibility succeeds without an unnecessary save.
Show moderation effects on the next Storefront product-page load without realtime synchronization.
Only authenticated ADMIN may update Rating Visibility; authenticated non-ADMIN roles receive 403.
